continuity.narrative_arc: A respectful question redirects worship from Indra to Govardhana and Brahmins; offerings are accepted, Indra’s pride grows into a storm plan, and Krishna steadies the cowherds before rain begins.
continuity.krishna_form_contract: Where Krishna appears, use the established krishna-vrindavan-youth contract: youthful cowherd, deep matte blue skin, long dark curly hair, yellow dhoti, muted red-orange shawl, plain smooth forehead with no mark, one simple low gold band and one upright peacock feather. He has one face, two attached arms and two legs. No hill lifting, four-armed revelation, or second physical Krishna occurs in D062. The chapter-scoped character file carries these rules; mapped photos guide story and cast context only.
continuity.indra_form_contract: Indra is a distinct adult deity with one head and two arms, simple crown and muted celestial garments. Never transfer Krishna’s peacock feather. One coherent elephant appears in stanza 9.
continuity.supporting_cast_contract: Nanda is mature and moustached in simple cream and muted green cowherd clothing. Cowherds and Brahmins appear as small groups of ordinary distinct people with natural proportions; do not clone figures.
continuity.palette_arc: Flat opaque matte mineral fields in warm cream, ochre, maroon, muted olive and established deep blue. Move from village warmth to restrained storm indigo and quiet assurance. No gloss, metallic gold, outer border or text.
continuity.batch_selection: art/batches/d062-comparison-v001.json; selected leads are pinned to exact candidate versions. Historical and superseded candidates remain preserved in the version inventory and are not shown as review alternates unless individually cleared.
